upstream_jars.comment: Real Wire 7.1.0 jars used by CompiledAgainstUpstreamTest and scripts/gen-upstream-getter-baseline.py. Fetched from Maven Central and verified by SHA-256 before use.

upstream_surface_jars.comment: Additional real Wire 7.1.0 jars compared by scripts/surface-check.py (TASK-34), together with wire-runtime-jvm.jar and wire-schema-jvm.jar from upstream_jars above. Fetched from Maven Central and verified by SHA-256 (pinned here) and by the SHA-1 Maven Central publishes before use; the check fails closed otherwise. The entries list sha256 before url on purpose: CompiledAgainstUpstreamTest scans this file with a url-then-sha256 pattern and must keep seeing exactly the four jars of upstream_jars.
